name: Antetonitrus
sum: Antetonitrus is a sauropodiform from the Early Jurassic Elliot Formation of South Africa, important for the origin of sauropod feet.
wsnote: No body-size figure was read in the sources consulted.
holotype: Not read in the sources consulted.
material: Fossils found by Kitching and later studied by Yates.
biology: Its feet were designed to support weight.
author: Yates and Kitching 2003

sources.text: Yates, A.M.; Kitching, J.W. 2003. The earliest known sauropod dinosaur and the first steps towards sauropod locomotion. Proceedings of the Royal Society of London B: Biological Sciences 270(1525): 1753–1758. doi:10.1098/rspb.2003.2417
